source.author: verg
source.text: Haec memorans cinerem et sopitos suscitat ignes, Pergameumque Larem et canae penetralia Vestae farre pio et plena supplex veneratur acerra.
source.text_original: Haec memorans cinerem et sopitos suscitat ignes, / Pergameumque Larem et canae penetralia Vestae / farre pio et plena supplex veneratur acerra.
source.text_english: Recalling these things, she stirs the ashes and the smoldering fires, and as a suppliant she worships the Pergamean Lar and the inner shrine of old Vesta, with pious meal and a censer full of incense.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: si enim uigiliis et ieiuniis macerat corpus suum et in seruitutem redigit, si flammam libidinis et incentiua feruentis aetatis extinguere cupit continentiae frigore, si appetitis sordibus turpare festinat naturalem pulchritudinem, cur e contrario balnearum fomentis sopitos ignes suscitat?
reuse.text_original: si enim uigiliis et ieiuniis macerat corpus suum et in seruitutem redigit, si flammam libidinis et incentiua feruentis aetatis extinguere cupit continentiae frigore, si appetitis sordibus turpare festinat naturalem pulchritudinem, cur e contrario balnearum fomentis sopitos ignes suscitat?
reuse.text_english: For if by vigils and fasts he macerates his body and brings it into slavery, if he desires to extinguish the flame of lust and the sparks of fervent youth with the chill of continence, if he hastens to defile natural beauty by seeking out filth, why, on the contrary, does he rouse the fires that have been lulled to sleep by the warm applications of the baths?
